##### Task 1a: Data Acquisition of State Electricity Profiles
```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| collapse: true 

library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(httr2)
library(rvest)

get_eia_sep <- function(state, abbr){
    library(tidyverse)
    library(stringr)
    library(httr2)
    library(rvest)
    library(fs)
  
    state_formatted <- str_to_lower(state) |> str_replace_all("\\s", "")
    
    dir_name <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
    file_name <- fs::path(dir_name, state_formatted)
    
    fs::dir_create(dir_name, recurse=TRUE)
    
    if(!fs::file_exists(file_name)){
        BASE_URL <- "https://www.eia.gov"
        RESPONSE <- request(BASE_URL) |> 
          req_url_path("electricity", 
                       "state", 
                       state_formatted) |>
          req_headers(
            `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0"
            ) |>   
          req_retry(
                max_tries = 4, 
          ) |>
          req_perform(file_name)
    
        resp_check_status(RESPONSE)
    }
    
    TABLE <- read_html(file_name) |> 
        html_element("table") |> 
        html_table() |>
        mutate(Item = str_to_lower(Item))
    
    if("U.S. rank" %in% colnames(TABLE)){
        TABLE <- TABLE |> rename(Rank = `U.S. rank`)
    }
    
    CO2_MWh <- TABLE |> 
        filter(Item == "carbon dioxide (lbs/mwh)") |>
        pull(Value) |> 
        str_replace_all(",", "") |>
        as.numeric()
    
    PRIMARY <- TABLE |> 
        filter(Item == "primary energy source") |> 
        pull(Rank)
    
    RATE <- TABLE |>
        filter(Item == "average retail price (cents/kwh)") |>
        pull(Value) |>
        as.numeric()
    
    GENERATION_MWh <- TABLE |>
        filter(Item == "net generation (megawatthours)") |>
        pull(Value) |>
        str_replace_all(",", "") |>
        as.numeric()
    
    data.frame(CO2_MWh               = CO2_MWh, 
               primary_source        = PRIMARY,
               electricity_price_MWh = RATE * 10, # / 100 cents to dollars &
               # * 1000 kWh to MWH 
               generation_MWh        = GENERATION_MWh, 
               state                 = state, 
               abbreviation          = abbr
    )
}

EIA_SEP_REPORT <- map2(state.name, state.abb, get_eia_sep) |> list_rbind()
```
##### Task 1b: Data Acquisition of 2025 Energy Consumption Report
```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| collapse: true  
  
load_ntd_energy <- function(){
  library(readxl)
  library(httr2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(fs)
  
  # Create 'data/mp02' directory if not already present
  DATA_DIR <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
  fs::dir_create(DATA_DIR, recurse=TRUE)

  NTD_ENERGY_FILE <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "2025_ntd_energy.xlsx")

  if(!fs::file_exists(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)){
    library(httr2)
  
    request("https://www.transit.dot.gov/") |>
      req_url_path("sites",
                   "fta.dot.gov",
                   "files",
                   "2026-09",
                   "2025 Energy Consumption_260806.xlsx") |> 
      req_headers(
        `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0") |> 
      req_perform(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)
  }
  
  if(file.info(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)$size < 1e4){
        cat("I was unable to download the NTD Energy File. Please try again.\n")
        stop("Download failed. Please delete the corrupted file by running `unlink('data/mp02/2025_ntd_energy.xlsx')` and try again.")
    }

  to_numeric_fill_0 <- function(x){
    x <- if_else(x == "-", NA, x)
    replace_na(as.numeric(x), 0)
  }

  read_excel(NTD_ENERGY_FILE) |> 
    select(-c(`Reporter Type`, 
              `Reporting Module`, 
              `Gallons of Other Fuel`, 
              `Other Fuel Description`)) |>
    mutate(across(-c(`Agency Name`, 
                     `Mode`,
                     `TOS`), 
                  to_numeric_fill_0)) |>
    group_by(`NTD ID`, `Mode`, `Agency Name`) |>
    summarize(across(where(is.numeric), sum), 
              .groups = "keep") |>
    mutate(ENERGY = sum(c_across(c(where(is.numeric))))) |>
    filter(ENERGY > 0) |>
    select(-ENERGY) |>
    ungroup()
}

NTD_ENERGY <- load_ntd_energy()
```
##### Task 1c: Data Acquisition of 2025 Agency Transit Service Report
```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| collapse: true 

load_ntd_service <- function(){
  library(httr2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(fs)
  
  # Create 'data/mp02' directory if not already present
  DATA_DIR <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
  fs::dir_create(DATA_DIR, recurse=TRUE)

  NTD_SERVICE_FILE <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "2025_ntd_service.csv")

  if(!fs::file_exists(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)){
    library(httr2)
  
    request("https://data.transportation.gov/resource/4fir-qbim.csv") |>
      req_url_query(`$query`=paste(
        "SELECT  `_5_digit_ntd_id` AS `NTD_ID`", 
        "`max_agency` AS `AGENCY`",
        "`max_reporter_type` AS `reporter_type`",
        "`max_organization_type` AS `organization_type`",
        "`max_city` AS `city`",
        "`max_state` AS `state`",
        "`mode`",
        "`type_of_service`",
        "`max_primary_uza_code` as `uza_code`",
        "`max_primary_uza_name` as `uza_name`",
        "`max_primary_uza_area_sq_miles` as `uza_sq_miles`",
        "`max_primary_uza_population` as `uza_population`",
        "`max_service_area_sq_miles` as `service_area_sq_miles`",
        "`max_service_area_population` as `service_area_population`",
        "`questionable_record` as `flagged_likely_inaccurate`",
        "`sum_unlinked_passenger_trips_upt` as `total_upt`",
        "`sum_passenger_miles` WHERE caseless_one_of(`report_year`, '2025') limit 50000", 
        sep=",")) |>
      req_headers(
        `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0") |> 
      req_perform(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)
  }
  
  if(file.info(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)$size < 1e4){
        cat("I was unable to download the NTD Service File. Please try again.\n")
        stop("Download failed. Please delete the corrupted file by running `unlink('data/mp02/2025_ntd_service.xlsx')` and try again.")
    }

  read_csv(NTD_SERVICE_FILE) |>
    mutate(flagged_likely_inaccurate = !is.na(flagged_likely_inaccurate))
}

NTD_SERVICE <- load_ntd_service()
```

##### Task 3a: First Question
```{r}
#| code-fold: true 

AnnualCost <- EIA_SEP_REPORT |>
# Delete columns not needed for the analysis.   
  select(-1, -2, -5) |>  
  
# Relocate and rename the column of abbreviated states.  
  relocate(3, .before = 1) |> 
  rename("state" = "abbreviation") |>
  
# Find the annual cost of electricity generated in each state.  
  mutate(annual_cost = electricity_price_MWh * generation_MWh) |>
  
# Find five states with highest annual cost of electricity.  
  ungroup() |> 
  slice_max(annual_cost, n = 5)

# Create bar chart of the five states.
  ggplot(AnnualCost, aes(x = reorder(state, -annual_cost), 
                         y = annual_cost)) +
    xlab("state") +
    ylab("annual cost") +
    labs(title = "Five States with Most Expensive Retail Electricity",
         caption = "State Electricity Profiles (www.eia.gov)") +
    geom_col(fill = "azure2", color = "black") +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 1, color = "white")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::dollar)
```

##### Task 3b: First Question
```{r}
#| code-fold: true

Agency <- NTD_ENERGY |>
# Find columns needed for the analysis. Delete "Gallons of" in column names.
  select("Agency Name" | starts_with("Gallons of")) |>
  rename_with(~ str_remove(., "Gallons of")) |>

# Combine rows with common agencies and add gallons for each fuel.
  group_by(`Agency Name`) |>
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>

# Calculate total gallons of fuels used by each agency. Relocate the total gallons column.  
  mutate(total_gallons = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)), 
                                     na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  relocate(total_gallons, .after = 1) |>

# Find five agencies that used most gallons of fuels. Delete columns with only zeros.
  ungroup() |>
  slice_max(total_gallons, n = 5) |>
  select(where(~ !is.numeric(.) | sum(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0))

# Create table of the five agencies.
library(gt)
  gt(Agency) |>
     tab_header(title = "Agencies that Used Most Gallons of Fuels in 2025") |>
     fmt_number(
       columns = where(is.numeric),
       sep_mark = ",",
       decimals = 0) |>
     cols_align(
       align = "center",
       columns = where(is.numeric))
```

##### Task 5: Calculate Emissions for Each Agency's Transit Mode
```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# Delete leading zeros in the agency IDs and select columns.
NTD_SERVICE1 <- NTD_SERVICE |>
  mutate(`NTD ID` = as.numeric(NTD_ID)) |>
  select(`AGENCY`, `state`, `NTD ID`) |>
  distinct()

# Join data sets and select columns.
Emission_1 <- inner_join(NTD_SERVICE1, NTD_ENERGY, by = "NTD ID") |>
  select(`AGENCY`, `Mode`, `state`, starts_with("Gallons of"))

# Select columns and rename the column of abbreviated states.
Emission_2 <- EIA_SEP_REPORT |>
  select(`abbreviation`, CO2_MWh) |>
  rename("state" = "abbreviation")

# Join data sets and delete columns with only zeros for gallons of fuel.
Total_Emission <- inner_join(Emission_1, Emission_2, by = "state") |>
  select(where(~ !is.numeric(.) | sum(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)) |>
  
# Use gallons per pound of carbon dioxide based on the EIA and EPA websites. 
  mutate(CO2_totalemission_lbs = `Gallons of Bio-Diesel` * 20.83 +
                                 `Gallons of Compressed Natural Gas` * 14.83 +
                                 `Gallons of Diesel Fuel` * 22.45 +
                                 `Gallons of Ethanol` * 12.68 +
                                 `Gallons of Gasoline` * 20.86 +
                                 `Gallons of Liquified Nat Gas` * 9.92 +
                                 `Gallons of Liquified Petroleum Gas` * 12.52) 
```
##### Task 6: Normalize Emissions to Transit Usage
```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# Sum the total UPT and passenger miles by each agency's transit mode. 
NTD_SERVICE2 <- NTD_SERVICE |>
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .by = c(AGENCY, mode, state)) |>

# Recode acronyms of "mode" with NTD Glossary. 
  mutate(n_distinct(mode), 
         mode = recode_values(mode,
          "AR" ~ "Alaska Railroad",
          "CB" ~ "Commuter Bus",
          "CC" ~ "Cable Car",
          "CR" ~ "Commuter Rail",
          "DR" ~ "Demand Response",
          "FB" ~ "Ferryboat",
          "HR" ~ "Heavy Rail",
          "IP" ~ "Inclined Plane",
          "LR" ~ "Light Rail",
          "MB" ~ "Bus",
          "MG" ~ "Monorail and Automated Guideway modes",
          "RB" ~ "Bus Rapid Transit",
          "SR" ~ "Streetcar Rail",
          "TB" ~ "Trolleybus",
          "TR" ~ "Aerial Tramway",
          "VP" ~ "Vanpool",
          "YR" ~ "Hybrid Rail"))|>
  
# Select columns and rename one. 
  select(1:3, 8, 9) |>
  rename("Mode" = "mode")

# Join data sets to calculate each agency's emission per UPT and passenger mile.
Transit_Usage <- inner_join(Total_Emission, NTD_SERVICE2, 
                            by = c("AGENCY", "Mode", "state")) |>
  select(1, 12:14)|>
  group_by(`AGENCY`) |>
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
  mutate(CO2emission_per_upt = CO2_totalemission_lbs / total_upt,
         CO2emission_per_passengermile = CO2_totalemission_lbs / sum_passenger_miles)

# Find the agency most efficient in carbon dioxide emission per UPT.
Efficient_UPT <- Transit_Usage |>
  filter(CO2_totalemission_lbs > 0) |>
  slice_min(CO2emission_per_upt, n = 1) |>
  pull(AGENCY)

# Find the figure of agency's carbon dioxide emission per UPT.
Figure_UPT <- Transit_Usage |>
  filter(CO2_totalemission_lbs > 0) |>
  slice_min(CO2emission_per_upt, n = 1) |>
  pull(CO2emission_per_upt)

# Find the agency most efficient in carbon dioxide emission per passenger mile.
Efficient_Mile <- Transit_Usage |>
  filter(CO2_totalemission_lbs > 0) |>
  slice_min(CO2emission_per_passengermile, n = 1) |>
  pull(AGENCY)

# Find the figure of the agency's carbon dioxide emission per passenger mile.
Figure_Mile <- Transit_Usage |>
  filter(CO2_totalemission_lbs > 0) |>
  slice_min(CO2emission_per_passengermile, n = 1) |>
  pull(CO2emission_per_passengermile)
```
###### CO2 Emission Efficiency based on Total UPT: 
The `r (Efficient_UPT)`, was most efficient at `r round(Figure_UPT, digits = 2)` pounds of carbon dioxide emitted per UPT. 

###### CO2 Emission Efficiency based on Total Passenger Miles: 
The `r (Efficient_Mile)`, was most efficient at `r round(Figure_Mile, digits = 2)` pounds of carbon dioxide emitted per passenger mile.

##### Task 7a: Agency with Highest Electrification
```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# Calculate the total "Kilowatt hours" for each agency.
Highest_Electric <- NTD_ENERGY |>
  select(`Agency Name`, starts_with("Kilowatt hours")) |>
  group_by(`Agency Name`) |>
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
  mutate(total_kilowatt_hours = rowSums(across(starts_with("Kilowatt hours")), 
                                        na.rm = TRUE), 

# Find the agency with highest percentage of total kilowatt hours.
         highestpercent_kilowatt_hours = round(total_kilowatt_hours/sum(total_kilowatt_hours, 
                                                                    na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
                                               digits = 2)) |>
  slice_max(highestpercent_kilowatt_hours, n = 1) |>
  pull(`Agency Name`)
```
The agency with highest electrification was `r (Highest_Electric)`.

##### Task 7b: Worst Non-Green Agency with Highest CO2 Emission 
```{r}
#| code-fold: true

Worst_Agency <- NTD_ENERGY|>
  filter(`Kilowatt hours of Electric Battery` == 0) |>

  select(where(~ !is.numeric(.) | sum(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)) |>

# Calculate the total gallons of each fuel for every agency.
  group_by(`Agency Name`) |>
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>

# Calculate total emissions with gallons per pound based on the EIA and EPA websites.   
  mutate(CO2_totalemission_lbs = `Gallons of Bio-Diesel` * 20.83 +
                                 `Gallons of Compressed Natural Gas` * 14.83 +
                                 `Gallons of Diesel Fuel` * 22.45 +
                                 `Gallons of Gasoline` * 20.86 +
                                 `Gallons of Liquified Nat Gas` * 9.92 +
                                 `Gallons of Liquified Petroleum Gas` * 12.52) |>

# Find the agency with highest total emission.
  slice_max(CO2_totalemission_lbs, n = 1) |>
  pull(`Agency Name`)
```

The worst agency with highest carbon dioxide emission and no green energy used was\

# Most Electrified or Non-Green Transit Agencies in 2025
####### NEW YORK, NY, November 6, 2026 (TRANSIT TIMES)
##### The MTA New York City used most electricity for transit in 2025 based on the total\ kilowatt hours of `r (Most_Electric)` agencies, reported by the National Transit Database\ (NTD).
##### On the other hand, `r (Least_Electric)` transit agencies neither used electricity nor\ hydrogen in 2025 according to NTD data. Among them, the Massachusetts Bay Transportation\ Authority emitted most carbon dioxide.

##### Two following figures show the five most electrified or non-green transit agencies,\ with the amount of carbon dioxide emission for the latter, in 2025. 
```{r}
#| echo: false

# Calculate the total "Kilowatt hours" for each agency.
Five_Most <- NTD_ENERGY |>
  select(`Agency Name`, starts_with("Kilowatt hours")) |>
  group_by(`Agency Name`)|>
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
  mutate(total_kilowatt_hours = rowSums(across(starts_with("Kilowatt hours")), 
                                        na.rm = TRUE),

# Find five agencies with highest percentages of total kilowatt hours.
  highestpercent_kilowatt_hours = total_kilowatt_hours / sum(total_kilowatt_hours,na.rm =                                                                  TRUE)) |>
  slice_max(highestpercent_kilowatt_hours, n = 5)

# Create bar chart of the five agencies.
  ggplot(Five_Most, aes(x = reorder(`Agency Name`, -highestpercent_kilowatt_hours), 
                        y = highestpercent_kilowatt_hours)) +
  xlab("agency") +
  ylab("% of total kWh") +
  labs(title = "Five Most Electrified Agencies in 2025",
       caption = "NTD Energy File (www.transit.dot.gov)") +
  geom_col(fill = "azure", color = "black") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 1, color = "white")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = scales::label_wrap(20))
```
```{r}
#| echo: false

# Exclude agencies that used neither electricity nor hydrogen.
Five_Least <- NTD_ENERGY|>
  filter(`Kilowatt hours of Electric Battery` == 0) |>
  filter(`Kilowatt hours of Electric Propulsion` == 0) |>
  filter(`Kilograms of Hydrogen` == 0) |>
  
# Exclude columns of energy with zeros.
  select(where(~ !is.numeric(.) | sum(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)) |>

# Calculate the total gallons of each fuel for every agency.
  group_by(`Agency Name`) |>
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>

# Calculate total emissions with gallons per pound based on the EIA and EPA websites.   
  mutate(CO2_totalemission_lbs = `Gallons of Bio-Diesel` * 20.83 +
                                 `Gallons of Compressed Natural Gas` * 14.83 +
                                 `Gallons of Diesel Fuel` * 22.45 +
                                 `Gallons of Gasoline` * 20.86 +
                                 `Gallons of Liquified Nat Gas` * 9.92 +
                                 `Gallons of Liquified Petroleum Gas` * 12.52) |>

# Find five agencies that emitted most carbon dioxide.
  slice_max(CO2_totalemission_lbs, n = 5)

# Create bar chart of the five agencies.
  ggplot(Five_Least, aes(x = reorder(`Agency Name`, -CO2_totalemission_lbs), 
                         y = CO2_totalemission_lbs)) +
    xlab("agency") +
    ylab("pounds of CO2") +
    labs(title = "Five Non-Green Agencies with Highest Emission in 2025",
         caption = "NTD Energy File (www.transit.dot.gov)") +
    geom_col(fill = "gray", color = "black") +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 1, color = "white")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = scales::label_wrap(24)) 
```
